venira.output_kind: push: pushed, message, selector, output. list: entries[] {selector, sha, subject}, count. apply/pop/drop: applied/dropped. show: files[], count.

description:
Stash push/list/apply/pop/drop/show. Push stashes staged+unstaged tracked changes (add include_untracked=true for untracked files).
Use when: you need to pause work to switch branches or commit selectively.
Avoid when: you need to stash and keep a copy (stash keeps one; use apply over pop) or drop permanently (prefer apply, then commit).
Output: push: pushed, message, selector, output. list: entries[] {selector, sha, subject}, count. apply/pop/drop: applied/dropped. show: files[], count.

action.description: push: stash changes; list: list stashes; apply/pop/drop: apply/pop/drop a stash; show: list files in a stash.

include_untracked.description: true includes untracked files when pushing.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to limit what gets stashed.

name: git_stash
title: Git stash
